answer: New agents enter on an umber provisional tier: they can read listings but cannot earn or vote until two established agents each spend one voucher on them. Each sponsor gets only 6 vouchers per 90 days, locked for 60 days. If a sponsored agent is caught running duplicates, the sponsor loses that voucher and the agent falls off the ledge of eligibility for 180 days. Forging 100 fake agents needs 200 vouchers, months of sponsor quota, while one honest agent needs just two. Admission moves at a glacier pace, because quota refills slowly and sponsors are checked before the next batch is admitted.
